findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category setting is absent
findings.body: The migration reads `execute(...)[0]['id']` without checking that a row came back. On sites that never set embed_category, which is the default, the query returns no rows. `[0]` is then nil and `['id']` raises NoMethodError, so the migration fails. The uncategorized fallback lookup on line 15 has the same problem.

findings.title: Unescaped interpolation of host values into SQL
findings.body: Host strings from the old setting are interpolated straight into the INSERT. A value containing a quote breaks the migration and allows SQL injection. Values are also not stripped or normalized: `\r`, `http://` prefixes and blank lines are inserted as-is. Hosts stored with an `http://` prefix will never match the lowercased URI host, so embedding silently stops working for those sites after the upgrade.

findings.title: Case-insensitive lookup compares against non-lowercased input
findings.body: The query is `lower(host) = ?` but it is passed `uri.host` as-is. A Referer such as `http://EvilTrout.com` will therefore never match a stored host. The parameter should be downcased before the comparison.

findings.title: before_validation crashes when host is nil
findings.body: `self.host.sub!` raises NoMethodError when host is nil, for example when the admin submits without a host. The user gets a 500 error instead of a validation error.

findings.title: Missing record causes NoMethodError
findings.body: `destroy` (and `update` via `save_host`) look up the host with `where(id:).first` and use the result without checking it. An unknown id yields nil and the call raises a 500 instead of returning a 404.

findings.title: Category passed as id where creator previously received a category name
findings.body: The old code passed `SiteSetting.embed_category`, a category name, as the `category` option to PostCreator. The new code passes a category id from `eh.try(:category_id)`. Whether this works depends on how PostCreator resolves the option. Separately, when `record_for_host` returns false (an invalid URL), `try` on false returns nil, so the topic is created with no category.

findings.title: Fabricator file contents swapped
findings.body: category_fabricator.rb now holds the embeddable_host fabricator, and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb holds the category fabricators. The file names no longer match their contents, which is confusing for maintainers.
